reviews.text: I had my gutters replaced on my home and I am so happy  I did.  Restore Roofing & Remodeling did an amazing job. They were all very kind and professional but yet friendly and even played with my dogs. They cleaned up and made sure  I was absolutely happy and satisfied and all was perfect and before they left. Thank you all at Restore Roofing & Remodeling.
reviews.author: PATTY SIMPSON

reviews.text: Emilio and the Restore team did an excellent job on our bathroom remodel. They were prompt and communicative every step of the way. I would not hesitate to use them again!
reviews.author: Matthew Fuentes

reviews.text: Hired Restore for a master bath remodel after were highly referred in a local group.  Restore exceeded my expectations with their attention to detail, quality of work and unyielding professional standards.  Even if I was okay with something Emilio would say “no, that’s not good enough” and have a thing redone.  I’ve since used them for big and small projects and they have not been disappointed- ever.  Highly recommend!  Worth every penny for the peace of mind that you are getting what you’re paying for and more.
reviews.author: Jennifer Robinson

reviews.text: I could not recommend a contracting company more. They just redid our bathroom and blew us away. Emilio had great communication, was organized and trustworthy. The stand out people were the two guys that did the actual job though.  Although Emilio really is a standout at his job.  I wish I had gotten the two men’s names. We’ve had a lot of people in our home to do projects and such but these two did quality work and were the most considerate workers I’ve ever met. If they knew I came home with the kids they instantly turned down their music (which honestly they could have let blare because I didn’t mind) but they also swept the hallway they walked out of at the end of every single day. They were truly so neat.  Their work is five star quality but all the people they employ are five Star workers and human beings as well. We will only be using them for home projects from now on. It’s time to save for a kitchen remodel with them.
reviews.author: Kali Moore

reviews.text: Extremely pleased with the way they handled our project. Timely execution and very high quality of workmanship!!!  Would definitely recommend Restore Roofing for your project. You will be equally pleased as we are!!!
reviews.author: Dan Jochumsen

reviews.text: Emilio and his team are great to work with. Reliable, honest, fair price. They did two bathrooms and kitchen. Could not recommend enough.
reviews.author: Patrice

reviews.text: I absolutely love working with Joe and his team at Restore! They are genuinely concerned about giving the customer their best. And they are definitely the best! My project involved completely overhauling my home’s exterior and constructing a new building on my property. Everything was done with attention to detail and excellent communication. A rare find… I highly recommend them.
